verdict: All organic signals are active; paid channels remain off across the group.
narrative: Across Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision, your Google Business Profile presence drove 418 combined actions this period — calls, direction requests, and website clicks — with zero paid spend running on any entity. That organic demand is real and measurable, but it is currently the only pipeline in motion. GBP momentum varied by location: O'Hare saw a 42% week-over-week rise, Forte matched that with a 100% surge, while Advance pulled back 30% over the same window. With paid search and social fully dark, intent that exists in the market is not being converted into tracked leads, and that gap is what the next period is focused on closing.

highlights.phrase: total Google Business Profile actions across all three locations in the last 28 days — calls, directions, and web clicks combined
GBP actions at O'Hare Precision alone this period, the strongest single-location organic signal in the group
paid spend across Meta and Google Ads for all three entities this period — no paid leads were generated

watch_item.issue: Paid channels are fully inactive across all three entities, leaving real search intent uncaptured and lead volume entirely dependent on organic GBP traffic.
watch_item.fix: Paid campaign activation is being prioritised as the immediate next step so that the demand already showing up in search and profile actions converts into a measurable lead pipeline.
